 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Bundesliga is back on the menu across the Bundesrepublik, as Martin Demichelis' RB Leipzig make the trip to face 1.FC Union Berlin at the Alte Försterei this afternoon.
 With around an hour to go until the scheduled 15:30 CET kick-off, both head coaches have revealed their starting lineups – you can see them in full below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Union Berlin vs. RB Leipzig lineups:
 Union Berlin (4-1-3-2): Rønnow – Haberer, Van den Bosch, Friedrich, Köhn – Khedira – Imeri, Schäfer, Aebischer – Burke, Ilic
 RB Leipzig (4-2-3-1): Vandevoordt – Baku, Orban, Lukeba, Raum – El Aynaoui, Banzuzi – Gruda, Baumgartner, Nusa – Rômulo
